description.value: Coffee + Kitchen is the on-site restaurant at WOODS on Pender, a glamping resort set on 7.3 forested acres adjacent to Prior Centennial National Park on Pender Island. By day it operates as an artisan coffee house serving fresh-baked pastries and Fernwood Coffee Company coffee; by evening it becomes a farm-to-table dinner restaurant with hand-crafted cocktails and a B.C. wine and local craft beer list. The restaurant is open to the public — not just resort guests — and features both indoor seating for up to 22 and a patio for an additional 16.

address.value: 4709 Canal Road, Pender Island, B.C., V0N 2M1
